shell_and_cutoff.prime_cutoff: finite shell sums commute with residue and multiplication by tau

positive_scope.closed: relative Evans-to-bordered comparison in the residue quotient modulo tau
positive_scope.not_closed: a positive norm on the meromorphic principal-part/residue extension compatible with the C34 common row
positive_scope.warning: the residue tau A is chain-exact, but a positive-definite energy cannot annihilate it away from the Xi divisor; positivity must be placed after restriction/derived quotient or on a hyperbolic pole-residue pair

noncollapse: The residue coordinate is supposed to vanish on Xi and therefore cannot itself witness noncollapse. Noncollapse must come from the retained source/pair coordinate, which survives the interval-cycle quotient and canonical codiagonal by source recovery.
next_test: Determine the C4 action on the diagonal conormal d(zeta-z) and combine it with the Tate phase. Then construct the minimal hyperbolic pole-residue block whose boundary pairing is Res_Delta and test whether its positive chirality is compatible with the existing Clifford endpoint crossing.
conclusion: Retaining the diagonal residue repairs the domain failure. Although the exponential homotopy has no diagonal Laplace value, its residue is tau times the entire shell transform A and is therefore explicitly null-homotopic through the Xi wall differential. The relative chain lift closes at residue level; positive realization of the pole-residue extension is the next gate.
